name: How do I choose the right wall finishes and materials for my garage?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right wall finishes and materials for my garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose the best finish, assess whether your garage serves as a clean home extension or a heavy-duty workspace. For walls, mold- and moisture-resistant drywall finished with washable, semi-gloss or satin paint resists dirt and cleans easily compared to flat contractor paint. If you run heavy tools, choosing impact-resistant drywall backing or wood blocking inside framed walls ensures sturdy support for hanging heavy equipment. During your consultation with Abraham Becerra, discussing what gear you plan to mount helps determine appropriate reinforcement behind the drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose washable, semi-gloss paint and durable drywall based on your garage use, and add internal wood backing if you plan to mount heavy tools or shelving.
